messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx and 429 rates detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error spike started ~1954320900. Paging on-call: @alex_oncall and SRE rotation.

alex_oncall: saw the page, joining. any customer-facing impact?

olivia_support: getting multiple reports of timeouts from a handful of customers, one reported "partial responses" and retries. Not widespread but a few high-traffic tenants.

jamie_sre: I'm on it. metric highlights: 429s climbed first, then 5xx + gateway timeouts. looks like quota enforcement fired and upstream services started failing.

maria_runtime: logs from the API gateway:
```
[1954320952] client_id=acct-49 429 quota_exceeded route=/v1/generate count=324
[1954320978] gateway timeout waiting for model-node (context deadline exceeded)
[1954320985] 502 upstream returned empty response
[1954321005] spike in conn_reset and backend 500s
```

jamie_sre: digging into quota service now. quick hypothesis: recent config that rolled out per-tenant caps accidentally applied a global enforcement key, causing many requests to hit a shared token bucket. When that bucket maxed, we started returning 429s back to the gateway, which then retried and overloaded the model pool, producing 5xx.

alex_oncall: can we confirm which config changed and when?

maria_runtime: config commit id: `cfg-2026-03-15-rl-7b` deployed at 1954320600 via config-service. It includes a policy: `quota.scope=global` for path `/v1/generate` intended to be `scope=per-tenant`. looks like human error in policy templating.

jamie_sre: ok that matches timeline. mitigation plan: 1) revert the quota config 2) open a temporary permissive bypass for the gateway for high-traffic tenants to avoid cascade 3) scale quota-service horizontally 4) add temporary circuit-break for backend retries. agree?

olivia_support: thumbs up from support side, will prepare customer comms if we expect >30m impact. Which tenants are affected?

jamie_sre: affected tenants: acct-49, acct-81, acct-210 (high request volume). We'll prioritize them for bypass.

maria_runtime: executing rollback now: `kubectl rollout undo config-service --namespace=prod --to-revision=cfg-2026-03-14-rl-6`

devops-bot: rollout undo started for deployment/config-service (prod) at 1954321120.

jamie_sre: while rollback runs, enabling permissive route in gateway for listed tenants. Command: 
```
POST /gateway/admin/bypass
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "tenants": ["acct-49","acct-81","acct-210"], "expires_in": 1800 }
```

maria_runtime: bypass applied at 1954321205. Quota-service pod count increased from 2 -> 6 (autoscale).

alex_oncall: do we still see 5xxs?

maria_runtime: 5xx rate dropping, 429s also declining. recent metrics: 429 1m rate down from 2.3k -> 120, 5xx from 1.1k -> 75.

jamie_sre: confirming rollback succeeded, config-service now at prior revision. removing global quota key and re-loading per-tenant templates.

maria_runtime: config diff snippet:
```
- quota.scope: global
+ quota.scope: tenant
```

alex_oncall: great. let's keep bypass for 15 more minutes and then remove once stable. any followups to avoid recurrence?

jamie_sre: action items: 
- CA1: Add CI lint rule to validate quota templates (owner: eng-runtime/maria_runtime)
- CA2: Add a canary gate on config-service for quota policy changes (owner: eng-infra/jamie_sre)
- CA3: Add per-route retry limits on gateway to prevent retry amplification (owner: eng-platform/alex_oncall)
- CA4: Notify affected customers + postmortem (owner: support/olivia_support + pm-maya)

olivia_support: drafting customer note, will share short template here.

pm-maya: for tracking - tagging this incident as incident-2026-03-15-quota-cascade. We'll need RCA and timeline.

jamie_sre: post-rollback checks: running synthetic probes and spot-checking tokens. 10m monitoring window.

maria_runtime: steady for 8m, connection errors returning to baseline.

devops-bot: bypass for /v1/generate tenants [acct-49,acct-81,acct-210] scheduled to expire at 1954323005 (automatic)

alex_oncall: I'll handoff to next on-call in 30m with notes. If anything flares, page me.

jamie_sre: starting RCA doc now. initial root cause: quota template misconfiguration (global scope) rolled out without template validation. Secondary cause: gateway retries amplified load.

olivia_support: customers notified: acct-49 and acct-81 acknowledged and say degraded but recovered. acct-210 still validating but looks OK.

maria_runtime: removing temporary bypass at 1954322700 now.

devops-bot: bypass removal executed at 1954322712.

jamie_sre: monitoring for 20m. if all good we'll close incident and move to postmortem.

olivia_support: closing loop with customers, will include timeline and next steps.

alex_oncall: handoff note -> issue resolved, root cause identified, follow-ups listed. Passing to @jamie_sre for RCA completion. I'm off-call at 1954324600.

jamie_sre: acknowledged, will finish RCA and owners will pick up action items.

incident-bot: Incident channel update: incident-2026-03-15-quota-cascade | status: mitigated | severity: Sev2 | responders: alex_oncall, jamie_sre, maria_runtime, olivia_support | timeline recorded.

alex_oncall: thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
